description: Reverse the characters in text exactly. Missing or null text is treated as empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to reverse. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: reversed
outputs.description: Returns the input characters in reverse order, or empty text when the input is missing or null.

description: Repeat text a bounded number of times. Missing or null text is treated as empty text, missing or null count uses one, and values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output. The resulting text must not exceed 65536 characters.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to repeat. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Number of repetitions from 0 through 65536 inclusive. Missing or null input uses one. Values outside this range fail before output, and the repeated result must not exceed 65536 characters.

outputs.name: repeated
outputs.description: Returns text repeated count times, or empty text for an empty input or zero count. Results above 65536 characters fail before output.

description: Measure the edit distance between two strings. Missing or null inputs use empty text. Each input is limited to 1024 characters. Values above that limit fail before output.

inputs.name: text1
inputs.description: First text to compare. Missing or null input is treated as empty text. Values longer than 1024 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: text2
inputs.description: Second text to compare. Missing or null input is treated as empty text. Values longer than 1024 characters fail before output.

outputs.name: distance
outputs.description: Returns the minimum number of single-character insertions, removals, or substitutions needed to transform one input into the other.

description: Return the characters of text in a random order. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text whose characters should be shuffled. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: shuffled
outputs.description: The input characters in a random order, with every character retained exactly once.

description: Convert text to a Soundex phonetic code. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to encode as a Soundex code. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: code
outputs.description: The Soundex phonetic code generated from the input text.

description: Convert text to a Metaphone phonetic code. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to encode as a Metaphone code. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: code
outputs.description: The Metaphone phonetic code generated from the input text.
